text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the construction of an intermediate school in the municipality of
Santo Tomas, Province of Batangas, as a memorial to General Miguel Malvar, and a like sum is appropriated,
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the construction of a central school in
the municipality of General Trias, Cavite, to be denominated "General Trias Central School," or for the
reconstruction of the present school.

The building to be constructed at Santo Tomas shall have on its facade, in bust or relief, the
effigy of General Miguel Malvar, and the one to be constructed at General Trias shall bear on its facade, in
bust or relief, the effigy of General Mariano Trias.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
